methodology.candidate_universe: fixed journaled candidates; quote-quality replay does not claim to regenerate strategy candles or candidates
methodology.costs: explicit costs once; no second spread deduction
methodology.live_validation_lifecycle: explicit historical entries become lifecycle-active at their recorded entry time; explicit historical exits close at their recorded fill time; missing fills use the shared lifecycle
methodology.live_validation_pricing: recorded broker fills when semantically explicit; otherwise validation_contractual_fallback, never an inferred broker fill
methodology.portfolio: unchanged cooldown, top-N, capacity and no-backfill contracts
methodology.primary_comparison: managed_v2 versus managed_v1_quote_quality_v2; identical quote-quality policy isolates selection-policy effects

v2_provenance.floor_policy: training segment prior clipped to [0.35,0.60] for Opportunity and [0.50,0.70] for Path; Economics fixed at 0.00% net; validation dates never consulted

labels.economics: conditional on Opportunity=1 and Path=1, net lifecycle return using side-aware executable prices and explicit costs once; no second spread deduction
labels.opportunity: executable MFE reaches the unchanged live breakeven trigger within the lifecycle horizon, including the counterfactual path after an earlier initial stop
labels.path: conditional on Opportunity=1, the protection threshold is reached strictly before the initial stop
